import hashlib,itertools,json,math,os,platform,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.special import ive
started=time.monotonic();source=Path(__file__).read_bytes()
input_path=Path(sys.argv[1]);raw=input_path.read_bytes();capsule=json.loads(raw)
expected='bd4d5e1d0e9fcfadef72cc9dba2cc4f7e6efacc6a577ee331fcd5b82574e5e49'
assert capsule['capsule']['source_sha256']==expected
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='centre-neutral-frozen-') as directory:
    replay=Path(directory)
    hashes={}
    for name,text in capsule['capsule']['source_bytes_at_IMPORT'].items():
        assert Path(name).name==name
        hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
        assert hashes[name]==capsule['capsule']['source_sha256_at_IMPORT'][name]
        (replay/name).write_text(text)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(replay))
    import covariant_root_transfer as root
    from covariant_induced_photon import Parameters,phi_frame
    gamma,_=phi_frame(Parameters())
    model=root.BosonicEdgeModel(4,((0,1),(0,2),(0,3)))
    number=sum((model.n(i) for i in range(4)),np.zeros_like(model.identity))
    indices=np.flatnonzero(abs(np.diag(number)-2)<1e-12);selector=np.eye(model.dimension)[:,indices];d=len(indices)
    assert d==6
    E={}
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(4),repeat=2):
        one=np.zeros((4,4),complex);one[i,j]=1
        E[i,j]=selector.conj().T@root.native_lift(model,one)@selector
    constraints=[]
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(4),repeat=2):
        target=(np.eye(d) if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]
        constraints.append(np.kron(E[i,j].conj().T,np.eye(d))-np.kron(np.eye(d),target))
    _,singular,vh=np.linalg.svd(np.vstack(constraints),full_matrices=False)
    C0=vh[-1].conj().reshape(d,d,order='F');C0*=math.sqrt(d)/np.linalg.norm(C0)
    particle_hole_error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(C0@E[i,j].conj()@C0.conj().T-((np.eye(d) if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]))) for i,j in E)
    assert particle_hole_error<1e-12 and np.linalg.norm(C0@C0.conj().T-np.eye(d))<1e-12
    _,basis=np.linalg.eigh(gamma[0]);frame=np.column_stack((basis[:,2:],basis[:,:2]))
    R=-1j*gamma[1]@gamma[2]@gamma[3];Rb=frame.conj().T@R@frame
    val,vec=np.linalg.eigh(Rb);minus=vec[:,val<0];Pminus=minus@minus.conj().T
    G=selector.conj().T@expm(1j*math.pi*root.native_lift(model,Pminus))@selector;C=G@C0
    kappa=1/(2*(math.expm1(.01)+4));momentum=(.3,.2,.1)
    phi=np.sqrt(np.array(Parameters().gram))[:,None,None]*root.SELECTED
    generators=root.matrix_unit_basis()
    tangent=np.column_stack([(1j*np.array([g@x-x@g for x in phi])).reshape(-1) for g in generators])
    real_tangent=np.vstack((tangent.real,tangent.imag))
    candidate=np.zeros((4,4,4),complex);candidate[0]=gamma[1]
    vector=candidate.reshape(-1);real_vector=np.concatenate((vector.real,vector.imag))
    normal=real_vector-real_tangent@np.linalg.lstsq(real_tangent,real_vector,rcond=None)[0]
    normal*=.003/np.linalg.norm(normal)
    yn=(normal[:64]+1j*normal[64:]).reshape(4,4,4)
    colour=expm(.04j*sum((math.sin(j+1)*g for j,g in enumerate(generators)),np.zeros((4,4),complex)))
    radial=np.zeros((4,4,4),complex);radial[0]=.003*gamma[0]
    zero=np.zeros_like(radial);identities=(np.eye(4),)*3
    cases=(('locked',zero,identities),('gamma0_radial',radial,identities),
           ('actual_normal',yn,identities),('colour',zero,(colour,np.eye(4),np.eye(4))),
           ('normal_and_colour',yn,(colour,np.eye(4),np.eye(4))))
    rows=[]
    for case,y,links in cases:
        transfers={}
        for sign in (1,-1):
            t,bp,bm=root.phi_wilson_step(gamma,kappa,momentum,sign*y,links)
            Tf=float(np.linalg.det(bp).real)*expm(root.native_lift(model,root.positive_log(t)))
            neutral=selector.conj().T@Tf@selector
            transfers[sign]=(t,neutral,bp,bm)
        t,Tf,bp,bm=transfers[1]
        image=C@Tf.conj()@C.conj().T
        rows.append(dict(case=case,normal_coordinate_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(y)),
            pointwise_onebody_inverse_defect=float(np.linalg.norm(Rb@t@Rb.conj().T-np.linalg.inv(t))),
            neutral_primitive_fixed_field_C_covariance_relative=float(np.linalg.norm(image-Tf)/np.linalg.norm(Tf)),
            neutral_primitive_Y0_reflected_C_covariance_relative=float(np.linalg.norm(image-transfers[-1][1])/np.linalg.norm(Tf)),
            actual_positive_neutral_min=float(np.linalg.eigvalsh(Tf)[0]),
            detBplus=float(np.linalg.det(bp).real),detBminus=float(np.linalg.det(bm).real),det_onebody=float(np.linalg.det(t).real)))
    assert rows[0]['neutral_primitive_fixed_field_C_covariance_relative']<1e-12
    assert max(r['neutral_primitive_fixed_field_C_covariance_relative'] for r in rows)>1e-5
    # Exact compact induced temporal-plaquette Fourier kernel, no added bare E2.
    beta=3.;Nt=7;cutoff=8;n=np.arange(-cutoff,cutoff+1);count=len(n)
    eigen=ive(abs(n),beta)/ive(0,beta);thermal=eigen**Nt;thermal/=thermal.sum()
    half=np.diag(np.sqrt(np.outer(eigen,eigen).reshape(-1)))
    rho=np.diag(np.outer(thermal,thermal).reshape(-1))
    shift=np.diag(np.ones(count-1),-1).astype(complex);curl=(shift-shift.conj().T)/(2j)
    B=(np.kron(curl,np.eye(count))+1j*np.kron(np.eye(count),curl))/math.sqrt(2)
    reversal=np.eye(count)[::-1];Cph=np.kron(reversal,reversal)
    K=np.diag(np.outer(eigen,eigen).reshape(-1))
    kernel_error=float(np.linalg.norm(Cph@K.conj()@Cph.conj().T-K))
    B_image=Cph@B.conj()@Cph.conj().T
    B_to_adjoint_error=float(np.linalg.norm(B_image-B.conj().T))
    ph=half@B.conj().T@rho@B@half;gram=float(np.trace(ph).real);ph/=gram
    conjugated=Cph@ph.conj()@Cph.conj().T
    trace_distance=float(sum(abs(np.linalg.eigvalsh(ph-conjugated))))
    assert kernel_error<1e-12 and B_to_adjoint_error<1e-12 and trace_distance>.1
    controls=dict(induced_temporal_plaquette_beta=beta,time_slices=Nt,integer_Fourier_cutoff=cutoff,
        actual_compact_transfer_character_formula='I_n(beta)/I_0(beta), ALL retained n positive; no electric wrapping',
        neutral_cycle_physical_dimension=count*count,actual_positive_transfer_min=float(eigen.min()**2),
        kernel_antiC_error=kernel_error,B_antiC_to_adjoint_error=B_to_adjoint_error,
        actual_moving_Curl_CP_Gram=gram,photon_CP_density_trace=float(np.trace(ph).real),
        actual_moving_Curl_CP_antiC_trace_distance=trace_distance,
        operator='B=(sin theta1+i sin theta2)/sqrt2 on two genuine integer cycle rotors. Cph reverses both electric n and conjugates coefficients, leaving A fixed. Real standing Curl multipliers are invariant, but the complex moving Fourier combination maps to Bdagger.',
        Gauss='Cycle holonomy shifts all edges around each cycle, hence divergence0; Ref4 is a fixed neutral spectator. This is a quantum compact-Haar CP discriminator, not a full macro photon scattering calculation.')
    result=dict(source_bytes=source.decode(),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
        input=dict(path=str(input_path),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),frozen_root_sha256=expected,replayed_source_hashes=hashes),
        runtime=dict(executable=sys.executable,python=sys.version,numpy=np.__version__,platform=platform.platform()),
        native_neutral_primitive_dimension=d,primitive_antiCAR_intertwiner_error=particle_hole_error,
        nonclifford_pointwise_controls=rows,moving_photon_CP_controls=controls,
        exact_normal_derivative='For Y0=eta gamma0, d log det(T1)/deta|0=-4kappa/b !=0, but detB and fixedN2 can cancel scalar chemical-potential effects. Actual neutral primitive Tf is therefore tested, not inferred from detT. General normal and colour cases are analytic on the connected positiveB domain; a nonzero fixed-fibre defect rules out an exact identity on any open chart. A jointly transformed field/connection law remains a separate possible symmetry.',
        raw_Ref_source_operator='With S=a† Psi r and literal Ref4, PiRef4 Sdag S PiRef4=[Tr(Psi†Psi)I-dGamma(Psi Psi†)]PiRef4. Cross terms retain W_y W_xdag across distinct body paths. A common path cancels only as an actual unitary common factor, not by replacing all path products with identity.',
        full_bundle_conditions='A full neutral antiC must specify transformed Phi and SU4 links, chart Fock connection, J, Dstat/Dcross and outside domain, plus actual photon/source CP operators. J(z)=J(z^-1) and statistical Z2 signs alone do not prove these. Even an invariant neutral vacuum kernel need not have an invariant fixed moving-photon CP density.',
        scope='Executed obstruction to fixed-field neutral antiC extension and to moving photon CP invariance. NOT a no-go for a jointly transformed full-field antiC law, NOT a chargedRef3 symmetry claim, and NOT a full interacting vacuum/scattering closure.',
        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(output=sys.argv[2],source_sha256=result['source_sha256'],frozen_root_sha256=expected,
        primitive_antiCAR_error=particle_hole_error,fixed_field_neutral_C_error=rows[-1]['neutral_primitive_fixed_field_C_covariance_relative'],
        reflected_field_C_error=rows[-1]['neutral_primitive_Y0_reflected_C_covariance_relative'],
        moving_photon_CP_trace_distance=trace_distance,elapsed_seconds=result['elapsed_seconds'])))
    print('Natural exit: frozen full-normal primitive neutral antiC and compact moving-photon CP adverse')
